vb_textbox.text: Hi please focus on x5 round more as these are worth more mushrooms. Try and get to the forest with most mushrooms look at the gnomes hat colours as these can get you to the forest with more mushrooms. If you are unsure just do your best im sure you will get lots of mushrooms good luck!!! :)
